settings.hero_lede: Exotic silk, cut for the body. Emerald, champagne, ruby — still-life, then motion.
settings.story_heading: An adult house of jewel silk.
settings.story_body_1: Femme is Silk Moments after dusk: lingerie, night, and lounge. Banners that breathe, fabric that moves. Every still is shot as a painting, then the film starts.
settings.story_body_2: Pieces are cut for 30B–42C and Free Size to XXL. Cash on delivery worldwide. A printable receipt at every order.
